notes.title: August 17th【BarbarQ 2】Close Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Chieftains,

The current testing phase will end on [b][i]August 17th at 23：59：59 UTC+8[/i][/b], and all player data will be cleared after the end of the test. We kindly ask you to bind your accounts to ensure that you'll receive badges and other official gifts when the game is officially launched.

Thanks for your understanding and support. All the feedback provided has been of great value to us, and it allowed us to deal with most of the issues that arose during the test.

Now, Joyland is about to undergo further maintenance and upgrades. 

We sincerely thank you for your participation and your continued support for BarBarQ 2!

BarBarQ 2 Team

notes.title: August 10th [Barbarq 2] Service Stop Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Chieftains,

We regret to inform you that Mushroom Hala's entrance will be temporarily closed.
The game will undergo a scheduled maintenance and will be inaccessible on [i][b]August 3, from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM (UTC+8)[/b][/i].

Key updates include:

Balance
1. Reduced BarBarQ/Valvyrie/WoWorker skills' base movement distance.
2. Changed K.K.Lion's Ult on-hit effect from Launch to Stun.
3. Increased the base damage of K.K.Lion skills.
4. Increased the base damage of K.K.Lion's epic weapon [Rock Hammer].
5. Reduced BOSS - K.K.Lion skill frequency in Bitieland 1-12.

Gameplay
1. Boomy Explosion will be open all day.
2. Island Raid will be open from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
3. Challenge Cardu will be open from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

Other
1. Optimized performance issues in Adventure.
2. Fixed the occasional crash issue in random events.

We appologize for any inconvenience, and appreciate your understanding and patience. Compensation of Emeralds*300, Gold coins*1888, and Wish Fire*1 will be provided after the maintenance. Thank you for your support!

BarBarQ 2 Team

notes.title: 【Barbarq2】Announcement on August 8th
notes.notes:
Dear Chieftains:

We are excited to announce the upcoming launch of the CBT testing phase. It's our pleasure to have you join us!
Time: 10:00 UTC+8, 27 August
This test will be a limited, non-pay-to-play closed beta test with no data retained.
Available in Indonesia
Chieftains can download the game through the steam Store. To thank you all for supporting BarBarQ2, we have prepared some special events!
Let's see what's new in Joyland!

Content:
1. All new Skin and Emoji systems.
2. 5 available Warriors: BarBarQ, Valvyrie, WoWorker, K.K. Lion, and Sasatta.
3. 2 competitive maps: Mushroom Mayhem and Island Raid.
4. Story mode: Bitieland
5. Witch and Elder Trials
6. New Casual Mode: Boomy Explosion.
7. New in-game VO and Quick Signals
8.Map, battle, character design, battle items, and talent improvements.
9. System improvements: Alliance and Leveling

Reminder: This test does not reflect the final product or quality, we hope everyone can continue to support us as we improve.

BarbarQ2 Operations Team
